requests.new: New: something arrived since you last opened this

items.saleOrders: orders waiting for a Manager to confirm, and orders ready to deliver
items.deliveryNotes: delivery notes to confirm when the goods leave
items.workOrders: order lines waiting for a work order, work orders to schedule, to start or to finish
items.fgTransfer: finished work orders not yet moved to the warehouse, and transfers to post
items.stockAdjustment: stock adjustments waiting for a Manager
items.stockStatus: materials that are short and not on order yet
items.purchaseOrders: orders waiting for approval or to send, and rejected orders to correct
items.goodsReceipt: purchase orders waiting for goods, and receipts to post
items.invoices: delivered goods with no invoice yet, and draft invoices to issue
items.bills: goods received with no bill yet, and draft bills to approve
items.receipts: draft receipts of money to confirm
